mcp-pro — the smart cache for MCP tool calls. Observe → Report → Cache.

  mcp-pro [--name <server>] [--config <file>] -- <command> [args...]
      Wrap an MCP server. Observe mode by default: nothing is cached.

  mcp-pro report [--json] [--days N]    redundancy and projected-savings report
  mcp-pro enable <server/tool>...       opt a tool into caching
  mcp-pro export-trace [--days N]       dump the log as redacted JSONL
  mcp-pro bench <corpus.jsonl>          replay a trace corpus, emit metrics
